Questions

Good to know

Is the check really free?

Yes. The scan and the report are free - we use it to show you exactly where your business stands in AI answers. No credit card, no commitment.

How is the score calculated?

We ask the major AI assistants the same questions your customers ask, then measure how often your business is named, whether it is recommended first, and who is named instead.

What happens to my details?

We use them to prepare your report and follow up about it. You can unsubscribe at any time - see our privacy policy.
